findings.issue: Qal participle masculine singular absolute has no article. «al» adds the definite article; singular enemy and object role stay.
Qal imperfect 3fs is smoothed to present «quiebra»; feminine subject, person, and qal stem stay.

notes: Both ימינך יהוה lines, niphal אדר with בַּכֹּחַ, and Jehová stay; no unmarked copula.
